name: Organization
description: Company, team, or enterprise entity. Name is case-insensitive unique. Access controlled via OrganizationMembership.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Organization name. Enforced case-insensitive unique via DB constraint.

fields.name: pilot_program
fields.description: True if created via open pilot signup

policies.name: Users can view orgs they belong to
policies.check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OrganizationMembership WHERE organization_id = Organization.id AND user_id = auth.uid() AND status = 'active' AND verified_at IS NOT NULL)

policies.name: Owners can update their org
policies.check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OrganizationMembership WHERE organization_id = Organization.id AND user_id = auth.uid() AND role = 'owner' AND status = 'active' AND verified_at IS NOT NULL)
